summary.text: Nicholas Begich is the Republican incumbent seeking a second term in Alaska's at-large U.S. House seat, to which he was first elected in 2024. A Chugiak resident born in Anchorage, he worked at Ford Motor Company before returning to Alaska in 2004 to start technology and investment businesses, including FarShore Partners and Dashfire. He previously ran for Anchorage City Council in 2016 and for this House seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Begich was born in Anchorage, Alaska, and, according to his congressional website, was raised by his maternal grandparents. He lives in Chugiak with his wife, Dharna, and their son.

He earned a B.B.A. in entrepreneurship from Baylor University in 1999 and an M.B.A. from Indiana University-Bloomington in 2002. Ford Motor Company then recruited him, and he worked there in technology, finance and product development before he and his wife returned to Alaska in 2004.

Back in Alaska, Begich founded FarShore Partners, a technology development company, and co-founded Dashfire, a startup investment firm. His congressional website also says he has served as a startup coach and mentor, and lists prior work with the Alaska Policy Forum and service as a board director of Matanuska Telecom Association.
He completed a fellowship with the Club for Growth and co-chaired both the Alaska Republican Party's Finance Committee and Rep. Don Young's 2020 re-election campaign.
Begich first sought office in 2016, running for Anchorage City Council (District 2, Seat A); he lost to incumbent Amy Demboski, 57.7% to 41.7%.
In 2022 Begich ran for Alaska's at-large U.S. House seat and finished third in the first round of the ranked-choice count, behind Mary Peltola and Sarah Palin; Peltola won.

He ran again in 2024 and defeated Peltola, 51.2% to 48.8% after ranked-choice tabulation, taking office in 2025. His committee assignments for 2025-2026 include Natural Resources, where he is Vice Chair of the Energy and Mineral Resources subcommittee, Transportation and Infrastructure, and Science, Space, and Technology.
